core_sentence: Electricity is becoming a permission slip for growth.
money_path: customer load -> utility/power company investment -> generation/grid work -> recovery/contract/market revenue -> customer bill or power payment -> cash
proof_boundary: Load, capex, backlog, PPAs, tariffs, and rate-base growth are not project-level cash proof.
next_proof_job: Build regulated recovery and billing proof stacks for a selected utility plus contractor conversion proof.

core_sentence: Big asset managers and insurers are money-routing systems.
money_path: saver/policyholder/institutional capital -> fund/account/insurer/BDC/CLO/legal wrapper -> borrower/asset/project/security -> fees/interest/spread/repayment/sale proceeds -> platform and investor economics
proof_boundary: AUM, deployment, dry powder, investment income, and fees do not prove asset-level cash return.
next_proof_job: Build named proof stacks for Apollo/Athene, KKR/Global Atlantic, Blackstone, BlackRock/HPS, Ares, or Brookfield.

core_sentence: Many industrial companies sell continuity, not just products.
money_path: customer operating need -> rental/parts/distribution/service supplier -> equipment/inventory/branch/support -> avoided downtime or completed work -> rental/product/service revenue -> cash
proof_boundary: Branch count, fleet size, backlog, and sales do not prove cash collection, fleet return, project margin, or collateral value.
next_proof_job: Run distributor and contractor extractions for Fastenal, WESCO, Grainger, Applied Industrial, MasTec, Sterling, or Jacobs.

core_sentence: Healthcare demand matters only if care can be authorized, staffed, delivered, reimbursed, and trusted.
money_path: patient need -> payer/PBM/provider/care site/pharmacy route -> authorized care/drug/service -> premium/reimbursement/spread/service revenue -> cash collection
proof_boundary: Revenue, covered lives, scripts, treatment volume, or EBITDA do not prove outcomes, fairness, labor adequacy, or service-line cash.
next_proof_job: Run healthcare access cash-quality bridge pass 2 across UnitedHealth, Cigna, DaVita, Addus, and Option Care.

core_sentence: The physical world sends recurring repair bills.
money_path: aging home/building/water system/road/HVAC/roof/pipe/paint -> owner/contractor/municipality -> retailer/distributor/supplier/contractor -> repair/material/labor -> invoice/payment -> OCF/FCF
proof_boundary: Repair demand, Pro growth, waterworks need, sales, backlog, price increases, and acquisition activity do not prove final cash quality.
next_proof_job: Run built-environment cash-quality bridge pass 2 across Home Depot, Lowes, Core & Main, Builders FirstSource, and Sherwin-Williams.

core_sentence: The internet made action cheap, so trust and permission became expensive.
money_path: user/device/bot/API/workload/AI activity -> identity/security/routing/policy/platform control -> subscription/billings/bookings/usage/service revenue -> retention and collection -> cost-to-serve -> FCF
proof_boundary: ARR, RPO, billings, bookings, traffic, users, AI exposure, and engagement do not prove durable digital cash quality.
next_proof_job: Run digital-control cash-quality bridge pass 2 across Cloudflare, Akamai, Zscaler, Fortinet, and Roblox.

core_sentence: Households spend to reduce regret under pressure.
money_path: household budget pressure -> store/app/membership/private-label/off-price/essential basket choice -> traffic/basket/membership/ad/gross margin -> inventory and cash conversion
proof_boundary: Traffic, sales, membership fees, private label, retail media, and gross margin do not prove cohort or cash durability.
next_proof_job: Run value-retail cash-quality bridge across Costco, Walmart, Target, Dollar General, and Burlington.

core_sentence: People buy time, relief, convenience, experience, status, and belonging.
money_path: consumer desire -> booking/hotel/restaurant/venue/casino/travel/franchise/loyalty route -> stay/meal/trip/event/service -> room/take-rate/franchise/food/gaming revenue -> cash
proof_boundary: Candidate examples do not prove source-visible cash until company packets extract traffic, price, loyalty, margin, and cash flow.
next_proof_job: Run company extraction for Marriott, Booking, McDonalds, Starbucks, MGM, and optional travel/media/platform names.

core_sentence: Ordinary products protect routine, trust, family, identity, and small control.
money_path: household routine/identity/trust need -> brand manufacturer -> retailer/distributor/direct/international route -> repeat product purchase -> price/mix/gross margin/cash
proof_boundary: Brand trust, price/mix, and repeat purchase do not prove volume health or durable cash without category and margin proof.
next_proof_job: Run company extraction for P&G, Colgate, Estee Lauder, Coca-Cola, Hasbro, Chewy, and optional household/pet names.

core_sentence: The modern economy still has a physical denominator.
money_path: end demand -> mine/mill/quarry/chemical/fertilizer/input producer -> physical material -> realized price/volume/margin -> working capital/capex/cash
proof_boundary: Input scarcity is not automatic cash proof before realized price, volume, cost, utilization, contracts, working capital, capex, and cash flow.
next_proof_job: Run extraction for Freeport, Nucor, Vulcan, CF Industries, Martin Marietta, Steel Dynamics, Dow, or Linde.

core_sentence: Place still matters when location controls access to users, tenants, power, logistics, care, or networks.
money_path: tenant/user/network/care/logistics demand -> scarce site/tower/warehouse/data center/clinic/store/hotel -> lease/rent/occupancy/escalation/payment -> property cash flow
proof_boundary: Location value is not cash proof without tenant cash, lease terms, debt maturity, capex, occupancy, replacement supply, and AFFO.
next_proof_job: Run extraction for American Tower, Prologis, Equinix, Welltower, Realty Income, VICI, Simon, or Digital Realty.

core_sentence: Technology is also chips, memory, storage, networks, equipment, security, and physical deployment.
money_path: compute/network/storage/security/customer need -> chip/hardware/software/cloud/equipment provider -> product/service/usage sale -> margin -> capex/inventory/working capital/cash
proof_boundary: AI or technology demand does not prove cash unless unit economics, capacity, customer ROI, supply, and cash conversion are visible.
next_proof_job: Run extraction for Microsoft, NVIDIA, Broadcom, Cisco, ServiceNow, Dell, Supermicro, Oracle, and add-on hardware/cloud names.

core_sentence: Medical need becomes revenue only through tools, diagnostics, sites, devices, distribution, reimbursement, and trust.
money_path: clinical need -> test/device/tool/site/distributor -> procedure/diagnostic/supply event -> reimbursement/product/service revenue -> cash if utilization and collection hold
proof_boundary: Procedure volume, installed base, diagnostics demand, or device revenue do not prove outcomes or cash quality.
next_proof_job: Run extraction for Abbott, Thermo Fisher, HCA, McKesson, Stryker, Exact Sciences, Labcorp, Quest, or Intuitive Surgical.

core_sentence: Energy affordability is a route from geology to usable daily life.
money_path: geology/reserves -> production/service/midstream/refining/LNG/power/fuel route -> contract/tariff/commodity/customer bill -> margin/DCF/OCF -> debt service and return
proof_boundary: Production, throughput, refining margin, tariff authority, LNG capacity, or price strength do not prove durable cash return.
next_proof_job: Build LNG cash-waterfall, midstream route billing, and refining cash-quality proof stacks.

core_sentence: Finance is the daily promise system for time, risk, payments, deposits, insurance, fees, losses, and liquidity.
money_path: household/business timing or risk need -> bank/card/network/insurer/payment platform -> loan/deposit/payment/premium/fee/claim route -> spread/fees/losses/capital -> cash
proof_boundary: Revenue, deposits, AUM, card spend, premium growth, or payment volume do not prove loss-adjusted durable cash.
next_proof_job: Run extraction for Progressive, Visa, Mastercard, Chubb, PayPal, BlackRock, Blackstone, KKR, Apollo, Ares, and additional finance names.
